prerequisites: It is recommended to have at least partially achieved the learning objectives established in the third-year courses Software Engineering and Information Systems, and the fourth-year course Web Technologies.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the objectives of a software system test plan, corresponding techniques, types, and test levels for risk prevention and obtaining the required quality.
Define the strategy and infrastructure necessary for performing software system tests.
Select and apply the most appropriate techniques for elaborating system tests at different levels and for different quality attributes.
Execute the content of a test plan, reporting and discussing the results obtained with the development or maintenance team.
Monitor the quality of a software product measured from the tests performed using appropriate tools.
Perform the production deployment of a software system in coordination with other stakeholders involved in IT management.

assessment_methods.method: Practicals (individual and team work, results delivery)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the final grade is a weighted average of theory (25%) and practicals (75%). For the extraordinary call, theory is evaluated by an exam (requiring at least 5 out of 10 points) and practicals use the ordinary call grade. If the theory requirement is met in the extraordinary call, the final grade is a weighted average of theory (60%) and practicals (40%); otherwise, the maximum final grade is 4 points. Students with differentiated evaluation will have theory assessed by an exam and practicals by lab assignments delivered on the exam date, with the same requirements and weights as the extraordinary call.
